prompt: The remote helper attaches a repo-scoped bearer token to the data-plane requests it makes. The hosts it dials come from a response header, redirect targets, and an on-disk node cache, any of which can name hosts outside the cluster the user actually addressed. Ensure that token is never sent to a host outside that cluster's trust domain, dropping such hosts at every entry point. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: remote helper sending token to off-cluster host
validate replica hosts against cluster trust domain
untrusted replica hosts from response header and cache
node cache poisoning redirects credentialed requests
_subject: remotehelper: scope repo-scoped token to cluster trust domain
